_about: Multi-region statutory scam patterns and transactional whitelist database for FraudGuard.

statutory_mappings.Section 13: Electronic Forgery — Altering, tampering, or deceptively producing electronic data, documents, or financial headers to defraud users.
statutory_mappings.Section 14: Electronic Fraud — Transmitting deceptive electronic messages or communications to dishonestly gain money, property, or valuable security.
statutory_mappings.Section 16: Unauthorized Copying or Transmission of Critical Data — Illicit access, harvesting, or transmission of protected subscriber or institutional records.
statutory_mappings.Section 17: Identity Theft / Unauthorized Use of Identity Information — Obtaining, harvesting, or using CNIC numbers, biometric records, banking passwords, or OTPs without authorization.
statutory_mappings.Section 21: Cyber Harassment & Coercive Communications — Transmitting intimidatory, coercive, or panic-inducing electronic threats (e.g., immediate account freeze, fake arrest warrants).

local_bank_otp_formats.description: HBL automated OTP delivery with security disclaimer
UBL automated Digital App OTP verification

education: Official BISP / Ehsaas messages ONLY originate from shortcode 8171, never from private 11-digit mobile numbers.
The Government of Pakistan NEVER requests advance payment or mobile balance load to disburse financial assistance.
Never forward or provide CNIC numbers to unverified personal numbers.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: BISP / Ehsaas Program Impersonation Fraud

I received an unauthorized communication falsely claiming eligibility for BISP relief funds and demanding fee payment.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 17

education: You cannot win a lottery or game-show prize (e.g. Jeeto Pakistan) you never legitimately enrolled in.
Any prize distribution demanding an upfront processing charge or mobile card pin is fraudulent.
Immediately report the sender to PTA (7726) and FIA Cyber Crime.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Lottery & Inami Scheme Advance Fee Fraud

I received a fraudulent notification claiming lottery winnings and soliciting advance release fees.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 13 & 14

patterns.statutory_violation: Section 14 (Electronic Fraud), Section 17 (Identity Theft) & Section 21 (Cyber Harassment / Coercion)
education: Banks and wallet providers NEVER telephone or message customers threatening instant account deactivation.
Official helplines are registered Universal Access Numbers (UAN), never personal mobile phone numbers.
Never divulge PIN, TPIN, OTP, or debit card CVV codes under any circumstance.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Bank / Wallet Impersonation & Panic Vishing

Fraudsters impersonated banking security personnel threatening account blockage to extort authentication credentials.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14, 17 & 21

education: One-Time Passwords (OTPs) are confidential access keys; no authentic institution will ever request your OTP.
Do not forward or read out SMS authentication codes to anyone, even if they claim to be family or customer care.
If you accidentally shared an OTP, freeze your account immediately via the official bank app.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Unauthorized Credential & OTP Harvesting

An individual attempted to obtain my one-time authorization credentials under deceptive pretenses.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 17

education: Customs officials and courier agencies never demand duty clearance payments into personal JazzCash/Easypaisa accounts.
Official customs duties are accompanied by legal Goods Declaration (GD) paperwork and paid through official NBP/State Bank challans.
Foreign 'gifts' requiring thousands of rupees to clear at the airport are classic romance/advance-fee scams.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Fraudulent Customs Clearance & Parcel Hold Scheme

An individual claiming to be a customs/logistics officer demanded money to release a purported overseas shipment.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 13 & 14

education: Any scheme promising guaranteed daily profits or returns on video-liking tasks is an illegal Ponzi fraud.
Scammers recruit via Telegram/WhatsApp and initially pay tiny amounts before freezing larger deposits.
Report illegal investment platforms to SECP and FIA Cyber Crime immediately.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Online Ponzi / Fake Daily-Earning Investment Scheme

I was solicited by an unauthorized platform promising guaranteed daily returns upon payment of membership fees.

Law: PECA 2016, Section 14

patterns.statutory_violation: Section 16 (Unauthorized Transmission of Critical Data) & Section 17 (Identity Theft)
education: Telecom networks never ask you to send your 13-digit CNIC or mother's maiden name over text message.
Attackers execute unauthorized SIM re-issuance to intercept banking OTPs.
If your SIM suddenly loses cellular network service, contact your telecom helpline from another phone immediately.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: SIM Swap Fraud Attempt

I received messages harvesting my CNIC under false pretense of SIM biometric re-verification.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 16 & 17

education: WhatsApp NEVER disables accounts for failing to forward messages to 10 friends.
Sharing your 6-digit WhatsApp registration code allows criminals to hijack your account and scam your contacts.
Always configure a Two-Step Verification PIN inside WhatsApp Settings > Account.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: WhatsApp Account Hijacking Attempt

I received a malicious prompt threatening an account ban to trick me into surrendering my WhatsApp registration code.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 17

education: PTA does not send random SMS alerts directing customers to third-party payment links.
Verify handset IMEI status exclusively via official DIRBS (dirbs.pta.gov.pk) or by SMSing your 15-digit IMEI to 8484.
Pay device custom taxes only through official PSID challans on 1Link / bank apps.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: PTA / DIRBS Tax Impersonation Phishing

I received a deceptive communication claiming my handset would be blocked unless tax was paid via an unofficial portal.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 13 & 14

patterns.statutory_violation: Section 14 (Electronic Fraud) & Section 17 (Identity Theft via AI Synthesis)
education: Scammers can synthesize realistic voice notes from short audio clips posted on social media.
Always call your family member on regular cellular voice to confirm identity before dispatching funds.
Establish a family safe-word to verify authenticity in purported emergencies.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: AI Voice Cloning Impersonation Fraud

A synthetic voice message mimicking my relative was sent to fraudulently extract emergency funds.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 17

education: Authentic corporate employers never ask candidates to send registration or interview security fees.
Offers of exorbitant remote salaries for basic data entry or video reviews are advance-fee frauds.
Never pay to secure employment.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Fraudulent Employment Scheme Demanding Advance Fee

I was sent a fake job offer requesting an advance registration fee via mobile wallet transfer.

Law: PECA 2016, Section 14

education: Meezan Bank never delivers SMS links requesting customers to input passwords or OTPs.
Never tap external URLs embedded in banking SMS messages.
Confirm all inquiries with the official Meezan helpline: 111-331-331.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: Meezan Bank Impersonation Phishing

I received a smishing link attempting to harvest my internet banking login credentials under Meezan Bank's name.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 13 & 14

education: Always call your friend or family member directly before sending emergency funds via Easypaisa or JazzCash.
Scammers compromise WhatsApp accounts and message entire address books demanding immediate financial aid.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: WhatsApp Family Emergency Impersonation

Someone impersonated my relative to solicit emergency financial relief into an unknown account.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 21

GLOBAL.statutory_framework: International Cybercrime Conventions (Budapest Convention / US CFAA / UK CMA / GDPR)

patterns.statutory_violation: Section 14 (Electronic Fraud) & Section 17 (Unauthorized Access & Identity Theft)
patterns.target: Crypto Asset Holders (Binance / MetaMask / Trust Wallet)
education: Never disclose your 12 or 24-word Secret Recovery Phrase or Private Key to anyone under any circumstances.
Neither MetaMask, Binance, nor Trust Wallet customer support will ever ask for your seed phrase or private key.
Do not connect your crypto wallet to unknown external dApps or unverified airdrop claim links.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing / Interpol Cyber Desk
SUBJECT: Cryptocurrency Wallet Drainer & Seed Phrase Phishing

I received a fraudulent prompt attempting to harvest my non-custodial crypto wallet recovery phrase under false pretenses.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 14 & 17

patterns.type: Global Courier Delivery Fee & Hold Phishing
education: DHL, FedEx, and Aramex never request credit card payments through shortened SMS links to release packages.
Always inspect tracking updates directly on official domains (dhl.com, fedex.com, aramex.com).
Legitimate customs clearance charges are backed by official airway bill (AWB) documents, not random mobile links.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing
SUBJECT: International Courier Impersonation & Customs Fee Smishing

I received a deceptive SMS impersonating international logistics carriers demanding payment via an unverified link.

Law: PECA 2016, Sections 13 & 14

patterns.type: Global Tech Account Suspension & Security Alert Phishing
education: Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Netflix will NEVER send text messages requiring you to disclose your password or 2FA code.
If you receive an account security warning, navigate independently to the platform's official portal (e.g. appleid.apple.com or myaccount.google.com).
Never click embedded billing update links received via unsolicited SMS.
patterns.complaint:
TO: FIA Cyber Crime Wing / Global Incident Desk
SUBJECT: Global Tech Account Suspension & 2FA Phishing

I received an urgent message falsely claiming account termination to capture login credentials and 2FA codes.
